criterion: per PDF of the Stressful PDF Corpus batch5.tgz, pdf.read (a file over the 1 GiB cap read through a file byte source) then every content stream of every page resolved, decoded and parsed to operators; ok when it returns or throws an error of the package's own hierarchy (PdfError) within the budget; a failure is an untyped throw, a hang, memory past the cap or a crash of the child
budget: 10 s per case for an input up to 10 MB, plus 1 s per further MB (hard cap twice the budget); 1 GiB peak memory
